title: AI Baby Meme Generator
summary: Free AI baby meme generator: make a baby holding in a laugh, a deadpan straight face, a side-eye or a suspicious squint, with a funny caption on top.
body_markdown:
### How do I make an AI baby meme?


Describe a baby, one exaggerated reaction face such as a straight face or a side-eye, and the setting, add the caption word for word, then generate the image.


### Is there a free AI baby meme generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every baby meme on this page, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### What is the AI baby holding laugh meme?


It is a picture or short clip of a baby pressing its lips together and puffing out its cheeks while trying not to laugh, shared as a reaction to something funny you are not supposed to laugh at.


### What is the AI baby straight face meme?


It is a baby staring into the camera with a flat, unimpressed face and half-closed eyes, used as a reply to a bad joke, an awkward moment or a plan that sounded more fun than it was.


### Can I add text to an AI baby meme?


Yes. Write the caption in the prompt after reading exactly, in capitals, and describe the font and position, such as bold white letters with a black outline across the top, and the model writes it into the picture.


### Can I turn an AI baby meme into a GIF or video?


Yes. Flick can animate a baby meme picture into a short clip with an image to video model, or into a looping GIF with Generate GIF.
